items.title: DeepSeek 发布 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 更新
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 是 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的一个小幅更新版本，在推理、编程、智能体任务及视觉基准测试上带来了显著提升，同时缩短了任务执行时间和输出长度。

evidence.quote: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash , delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks.

Alongside these gains, the model reduces task execution time and output length, enabling users to complete tasks faster and at lower cost and advancing the performance–cost Pareto frontier across multiple agent harnesses.

items.title: Liquid AI 发布端到端全模态模型 LFM3-Omni-2B
items.summary: Liquid AI 推出了首款全模态模型 LFM3-Omni-2B，参数量为 2.2B，能够同时理解文本、图像、视频和音频，并以文本和语音进行响应，适合在手机和边缘设备上运行。

evidence.quote: LFM3-Omni-2B is Liquid AI 's first omni-modal model in the LFM3 family: a single end-to-end model that understands text, images, video and audio , and answers in text and speech .
Small enough for devices: at 2.2B parameters, it is designed to run efficiently on phones, laptops and other edge hardware.

items.title: Soft-MTP：通过 KL 梯度恢复技巧改进多 Token 预测
items.summary: 研究人员发现标准多token预测（MTP）训练中的残差会干扰学习，并引入了 KL 梯度恢复技巧，推出了 Soft-MTP，通过一行代码改动移除了噪声残差并提升了下游性能与推理速度。

evidence.quote: We identify a flaw in standard MTP training, in which a residual component of the MTP gradient interferes with both next-token and multi-token learning, increasingly so with scale.

This enables Soft Multi-Token Prediction ( Soft-MTP ), a one-line code change to MTP that removes the noisy residual and backpropagates only the KL self-distillation signal by reusing the existing NTP and MTP cross-entropy computations.

items.title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching：将显式矩约束引入少步文本生图
items.summary: 论文介绍了内在分布匹配（IDM），在分布匹配蒸馏中加入显式矩约束，在少步文本生成中实现了优异的中文和英文 LongText-Bench 表现，无需外部特征编码器。

evidence.quote: o Li , Tao Lin Abstract Intrinsic Distribution Matching improves few-step text-to-image generation by adding explicit moment constraints to distribution matching distillation, achieving state-of-the-art long-text rendering with minimal network evaluations.

We introduce Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM), which retains the full DMD correction and matches feature means and per-coordinate standard deviations using the generator's exponential-moving-average (EMA) copy, requiring no external feature encoder.
